title: Verify: BootScene and PhaserHost 3.90 lifecycle unit tests
summary: Mocked tests for shutdown cleanup, resize and destroy
description: Write tests/phaser390Lifecycle.test.tsx with phaser and createGame mocked. Assert BootScene shutdown unsubscribes, PhaserHost calls scale.refresh and destroy(true), and the sources contain no Phaser 4-only API.
acceptance_criteria: Given BootScene.create run with a fake events emitter, when SHUTDOWN fires, then the zustand unsubscribe is called.
Given PhaserHost rendered with createGame mocked returning {scale:{refresh},destroy}, when unmounted, then destroy is called once with true.
Given a mocked ResizeObserver callback, when invoked, then scale.refresh is called.
Given BootScene.ts and PhaserHost.tsx source, when scanned, then no Phaser 4 filter API matches.

steps.action: Create the test file, mirroring mocking from tests/bootScene.test.ts and tests/phaserHost.test.tsx. Test 1: stub phaser Scene and Scenes.Events.SHUTDOWN, call create(), fire SHUTDOWN, assert the zustand unsubscribe spy ran. Test 2: vi.mock('../src/phaser/createGame') returning {scale:{refresh: vi.fn()}, destroy: vi.fn()}; render PhaserHost, trigger the captured ResizeObserver callback, assert refresh called; unmount, assert destroy toHaveBeenCalledWith(true) once. Test 3: read both source files and expect no match for /Filters|enableFilters|setFilter/.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/phaser390Lifecycle.test.tsx
